addonDescription.message: Identify available media for a video and open a download in VersaDown.

detectAllHelp.message: Works on Bilibili, YouTube, and X by default. Enabling this option asks Chrome for access to additional websites.

detectAllDenied.message: Chrome did not grant access to additional websites.

detectAllEnabled.message: Enabled. Reload other open pages to detect their videos.

detectAllError.message: Could not apply the detection setting. Try again.

buttonTitle.message: Show download options for this video

checking.message: VD is finding downloadable qualities for this video…

noVideoTarget.message: VD could not identify a download address for this player.

noDownloadFormats.message: VD could not find downloadable qualities for this video.

hostUpgrade.message: Update and re-register VD to use VersaDown+.

videoRestricted.message: This site requires sign-in or restricts this video. Check VD’s video download settings.

videoNetwork.message: VD could not read this site’s video data. Check your network or VD’s proxy settings.

videoDrm.message: This site only provides protected media.

noMedia.message: No file, manifest, or audio/video track pair could be matched to this video.

playToIdentify.message: Start playback to load media information.

sabrPlayback.message: YouTube offers a SABR playback session for this video. VD cannot download that session format yet.

protectedMedia.message: This player is using protected media.

hostUnavailable.message: Cannot reach VD. Check that its Chrome native host is installed and registered.

hostRejected.message: VD did not accept this task. Check the media source.

extensionError.message: The extension could not finish this request. Reload the page and try again.

reportedOnly.message: The player reports $HEIGHTS$. No media address could be handed to VD for these qualities. No task was created.

selectionExpired.message: These options expired. Click the video download button again.

chooseSource.message: Choose a video source to download

openPublicEmbed.message: View this post’s videos in X’s official embed

unboundManifest.message: This page requested a media manifest, but its player could not be identified.

sourceHttpError.message: The media server returned HTTP $STATUS$ for the selected file. No VD task was created.

sourceNotFile.message: The selected address did not return a recognizable media file. No VD task was created.

sourceUnreachable.message: Could not connect and read the selected media. No VD task was created.

additionalHeights.message: The player also lists $HEIGHTS$ without individual media addresses.
